purpose: Integrity manifest for the reviewed transparent avatar media shipped with this portfolio.

validation.format: WebM / VP9 with an alpha plane and Opus audio
validation.sourceBackground: Light-gray checkerboard baked into source MP4; processed into a transparent matte for the VP9 WebM. The original MP4 is retained only for Safari canvas-keying fallback.

backgroundArtifactsRemoved: Light checkerboard remnants between the left-side hand/fingers and beside the hanging hand
Pale checkerboard wedge and thin gray edge slivers in the inner viewer-right elbow/sleeve gap
localizedMatteCorrection.method: Detect source-colored near-neutral background pixels, grow the matte only into connected pixels within the two audited negative-space zones, and preserve alpha outside those local masks.
